guarantees.claim: sparse_fsm_error is a combinational OR of the six listed error signals; it is high when any of them is high, and low only when all are low.

uncertain_points.claim: The aggregation of six distinct error signals into a single bit (sparse_fsm_error) loses error-source identity, which could complicate fault containment, diagnosis, or error-specific recovery in downstream logic.
uncertain_points.cond: when two or more error sources assert simultaneously or when the system requires specific error quarantining
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream safety or security mechanisms that rely on differentiating error types may not function as intended, potentially leading to incomplete error handling or violation of integrity response requirements.
